hero.title: All About Cane
hero.sub: From a humble crop to a drink loved across generations.

intro.title: Sugarcane Has Fed, Healed And Sweetened Millions Of Lives
intro.sub: It feeds, heals, sweetens, and sustains millions of lives. At The Cane House, we celebrate its journey, its goodness, and its incredible story.

items.label: Renewable & Sustainable
items.note: Grows back season after season, giving far more than it takes.

items.label: Naturally Nutritious
items.note: Packed with natural energy and minerals, nothing added.

items.label: Supports Farmers
items.note: Every glass supports the growers who work the fields.

items.label: Goodness In Every Sip
items.note: Pressed fresh, so none of its natural goodness is lost.

story.tag: From Ancient Fields To Modern Times
story.title: Story Of Sugarcane
story.sub: Sugarcane has been part of human civilisations for thousands of years. It has sweetened celebrations, strengthened communities, and stood the test of time.

photos.label: Working The Fields
photos.desc: The way it has always been done.

photos.label: Hand-Cut Harvest
photos.desc: Cut with care at the perfect time.

photos.label: Pressed Fresh
photos.desc: From field to glass, the same day.

history.title: History Of Sugarcane
history.sub: Originating in New Guinea, sugarcane spread across Asia, the Middle East, Europe and the world. It played a vital role in trade, economies and cultures for centuries.

items.label: Planting
items.desc: Healthy setts planted in rich, fertile soil.

items.label: Growth
items.desc: Grows strong under sunlight, water & care.

items.label: Maturation
items.desc: Over 10-14 months, it reaches full maturity.

items.label: Harvesting
items.desc: Hand-cut with care at the perfect time.

items.label: Transport
items.desc: Cane is carried fresh to the mill.

items.label: Extraction
items.desc: Juice is pressed fresh from the cane.

culture.title: Sugarcane In Our Culture
culture.sub: A part of festivals, traditions, rituals and celebrations. It connects generations and brings people together.

items.question: Is sugarcane juice safe for diabetics?
items.answer: In moderation, and best discussed with your doctor - it is naturally sweet with no added sugar, but still a source of natural sugars.

items.question: Does sugarcane juice have calories?
items.answer: Yes, naturally - it's a whole-plant drink, not a diet product, but it has none of the artificial additives found in most soft drinks.

items.question: How is your juice different?
items.answer: Pressed fresh in front of you, from cane sourced the same day - never bottled, never stored.

items.question: Is your juice 100% natural?
items.answer: Yes - no added sugar, colours, or preservatives, ever.

items.question: How should I store it?
items.answer: It's best enjoyed fresh, right after pressing - like any fresh juice, it doesn't keep well overnight.

closing.title: The Sweetest Story Ever Told
closing.sub: Sugarcane is more than a crop. It is a legacy. A gift from nature. A symbol of life. At The Cane House, we honour this timeless sweetness, and bring it to you - fresh, pure, and full of goodness.
